_about: ATR 72-500/-600 (AT75, AT76), from ATR's ATR 72-500 spec sheet (ATR family brochure, 2019, its page 20, published on atr-aircraft.com): a dimensioned side, plan and front view, vector, drawn as an illustration (shaded, its lines from black to pale grey: layers.py --mode lines --contrast 20). ATR's Airport Planning Manuals aren't public (its customer portal); the 72-600's own fact sheet draws the same three views (same printed figures) as a picture, so the 72-500 sheet's vector drawing is used: the 72-600 is the same airframe (27.166 m, 27.05 m span, 3.93 m propellers, the same six-bladed 568F). The plan view is drawn turned 45 degrees, rendered at scale 40.33 (the side's scale by the nose-to-tail length) and turned level; the front view at 39.70 (by the printed 27.05 m span). Pixels of those rasters, line centres. Scaled by the printed 27.166 m length, nose to tail cone. The plan draws the nacelles 4.4% further out than the front view and the printed 8.10 m between the propellers: the engine's place is the front view's propeller disc. Doors as the left side view draws them: the forward cargo door (left only: Commons photos of the right side show none there), the forward exit and the aft door (on both sides: the right side's forward exit and aft service door are about opposite, as photos show).

sources.title: ATR, ATR 72-500 (ATR family brochure, 2019, page 20): side, plan and front views with their dimensions
sources.note: Outlines read off the sheet's three views (tools/trace/at76/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. ATR's Airport Planning Manuals aren't published on its public site; this is ATR's own dimensioned drawing, drawn as an illustration, so its confidence is medium. The 72-600 is the same airframe as the 72-500 (ATR's 72-600 fact sheet prints the same dimensions over the same views, as a picture). The plan view is drawn turned and was turned level; it draws the nacelles 4.4% further out than the front view and the printed propeller spacing, which the shape keeps. Doors from the side view; their sides from photos (below).

sources.title: ATR, ATR 72-600 fact sheet
sources.note: The 72-600's dimensions: the same as the 72-500's.
